datasheet_identity.title: SS22B THRU SS220B SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER (SMB Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier)

extraction_notes: Family datasheet SS22B-SS220B; SS220B ratings: VRRM = VDC = 200 V and VRMS = 140 V; IF(AV) = 2.0 A and IFSM = 50 A at 8.3 ms half-sine are common ratings (p. 1).
Merged-cell resolution on p. 2: VF maximum 0.95 V is SS220B only; IR1 maximum 0.2 mA is SS215B-SS220B; IR2 maximum 2.0 mA is SS215B-SS220B; CJ typical 180 pF spans SS25B-SS220B.

The SS215B-SS220B forward trace was digitized from the printed linear-voltage/log-current grid on p. 2. Fig.1 and Fig.2 are thermal/surge ratings. Fig.4 is a normalized reverse-characteristics plot against percent of rated reverse voltage and was not used as an absolute-voltage curve.
No reverse recovery time or measured avalanche/breakdown row is published; VRRM is an absolute maximum rating, not a measured breakdown.
Curve axis current is preserved as SI amperes; table microamp/milliamp values were converted to amperes in specs.
